def save_message(message, output_file):
    with open(output_file, 'w') as file:
        file.write(message)

message = "Hello, world!"
output_file = "output.txt"
save_message(message, output_file)
print(f"Message saved to {output_file}")
```

You can run this script in a Python environment and it will save the message "Hello, world!" to a file named "output.txt".
